instrument: Texas Attorney General investigation of data center developments that did not answer the state water-use survey
summary: The Attorney General is reported to be investigating data center developments across 18 counties that did not respond to the state's water-use survey. No end date or exit criteria are published.

source.citation: Foley & Lardner client alert (Sept 24, 2026) as cited in secondary coverage

confidence_note: Investigation notices not read; scope and county list not confirmed.
